mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right AEO provider for my roofing business?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting an AEO provider, look for agencies with a proven track record in digital marketing, ideally with experience in the home services or construction industry. Key factors include their understanding of your local market (e.g., New York City, Los Angeles), their ability to demonstrate past successes with case studies, and a transparent reporting process. Ensure they focus on creating high-quality, authoritative content that directly answers customer queries rather than just keyword stuffing. A good provider will conduct thorough research to understand your target audience and competitive landscape.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an AEO provider with proven digital marketing and home services experience. Look for local market understanding, transparent reporting, and a focus on high-quality, authoritative content.
